reason: The strategy relies on 1-minute chart patterns and intraday breakouts immediately after market open on gapping stocks, which cannot be approximated on daily bars.

universe.description: mid/big cap US stocks gapping and moving 10-20% daily

setup.rule: stock creates range in first 3-4 candles after open
setup.quote: I'm looking at the first business of opening of the market like three to four candles consider dating in a Range so once it breaks out and started buying

entry.rule: breakout of range highs or retest
entry.quote: if it breaks out to the highs I will start buying then it goes to back and retest I will buy again and if it breaks out again I will buy again

stop.quote: my stop also be under the lows

exits.rule: 1:1 RR or system close at end of day
exits.quote: The TP is only one is to one and just ten to five at 10 to 15 minutes I'm done trading

sizing.quote: raised only one percent per trade

ambiguities.issue: also mentions swing trading and shorting on personal account
